Rikke Therkildsen is a consultant physician (*overlæge*) affiliated with Aarhus University Hospital in the Central Denmark Region (*Region Midtjylland*) [^src1]. She serves as a member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]], representing the Danish Surgical Society (*Dansk Kirurgisk Selskab*) [^src1]. Her role on the steering group ensures surgical professional representation from the Central Denmark Region within the governance structure of the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB), a national clinical quality database operating under the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1].
